n: A row you code under a filter stays in the list (marked yellow) until you change the filter – or press Refresh
Enter and Ctrl+D always move on to the next row
Import codes… takes several files at once (e.g. the Material report and the Subcontractor report)
Create the register with several last reports – e.g. the Material report and the Subcontractor report together; the codes of all of them come in
The earlier Material report: its Data tab codes each issue line (Material doc.) – a line coded other than its material keeps its own code
A report of another project asks before its codes are read
Codes › PKG list shows the whole list – no filter buttons; a PKG without a name says "No name yet" on its row
You choose when to update: a new version shows in the top bar with What's new, Update and Later – nothing changes until you press Update
Your data file is never touched by an update
Monthly job: step 4 opens what is still open; step 5 has Export the monthly report
